chunk-001:c001.proposition: Life-permitting parameters are extremely improbable under single-universe naturalism but less surprising if a perfectly good God values conscious moral life, so fine-tuning confirms theism.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently states the fine-tuning datum, the rival conditional likelihoods, and the resulting evidential inference without depending on an opposing move.

chunk-001:c006.proposition: Allowing a tailored natural disposition to match any observation would defeat every possible empirical case for theism, an implausibly sweeping consequence of the stalking-horse method.

orphanFallback.rationale: As a standalone argument, the move establishes a general limit on tailored naturalistic explanations by tracing their use to the loss of all possible empirical discrimination.

chunk-001:c008.proposition: The relevant claim compares classical perfect-being theism with every hypothesis consistent with single-universe naturalism, understood as the causal natural order exhausting relevant reality.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move can independently define both comparison classes and state the breadth of the pro burden, even without an earlier challenge requesting clarification.

chunk-002:c002-04.proposition: Perfect divine goodness provides some basis for expecting revealed religion and resurrection, whereas a generic alien hypothesis supplies no comparable expectation without added specificity.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposition independently derives a comparative expectation from perfect goodness and explains why specifying matching alien intentions transfers the improbability into the rival hypothesis.

chunk-002:c002-06.proposition: Perfect-being theism occupies a substantial share of general design possibilities, while a life-directed augmented-naturalistic hypothesis occupies an extremely small share of general naturalistic possibilities.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move stands alone as a comparative intrinsic-probability argument by locating each specific hypothesis within its broader design or naturalistic possibility space.

chunk-002:c002-08.proposition: A simulation hypothesis is independently skeptical and merely relocates fine-tuning to base reality because a simulator would probably reproduce the basic physical laws instantiated in the simulation.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently evaluates simulation as a naturalistic alternative and argues that it relocates rather than explains the fine-tuning requiring explanation.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-03.proposition: The modesty of a disjunction of limited alternatives does not by itself show that it outranks theism intrinsically, because coherence may carry greater prior-probability weight than modesty.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently identifies coherence and modesty as distinct determinants of intrinsic probability and denies that modesty has an assumed overriding weight.
